blocks.html:
Live loads shall not be reduced for calculating shear stresses at the heads of columns in flat slab or flat plate construction.
(Am. L.L. 2023/077, 6/11/2023, eff. 6/11/2023)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2023/077.
